steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: 'State' requires a brief factual answer without explanation; just give the fact or definition directly. | Key Fact: 'Describe' requires saying what happens or what a process is, without explaining why it happens. | Key Fact: 'Explain' requires giving reasons — say what happens and why, linking cause and effect in your answer. | Key Fact: 'Compare' requires stating similarities and differences between two or more things; use comparative language.

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from command words &amp; question types, and one past-paper question.
